svg.title: Slab TE characteristic intersections
svg.desc: nc=1.5, ns=1.45, lambda0=850 nm; Vn panels=0.5, 1, 2
svg.text: nc=1.5, ns=1.45, lambda0=850 nm; Vn panels=0.5, 1, 2
Blue: u tan(u), even TE; orange dashed: -u cot(u), odd TE.
Green: w = sqrt(Vn^2-u^2); black circles: computed intersections.
Only positive physical branches 0 < u < Vn; pole ends are not joined.
